transcript.text: Alright everyone, we're two weeks out from the first production customer launch for the event-ingestion service. We need to settle on an architecture today. Per our normal routine, I'd like to hear the final check from application architecture and the final check from compliance before I record the operating plan. Both architectures passed the functional test suite in dev, so we're good on that front — now I need your final input so I can make the binding decision. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated replay tool yesterday, I measured a launch-period burst of about 18,000 events per minute that the hourly batch design cannot process within the customer-facing latency target. The streaming design needs exactly 12 partitions to handle that load. I haven't yet updated the architecture document because the replay test was outside the launch checklist, but this is critical information for the architecture decision.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance constraint I confirmed with the privacy office this morning but hadn't yet added to the launch review because it came through a separate compliance system. The first customer's event payloads must remain in the EU and be retained for exactly 400 days for an audit requirement. Whichever architecture we choose must satisfy both the data residency and retention requirements.
